shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवद्भिर्ऋषिभिः काकुत्स्थो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । किं कार्यं ब्रूत मुनयो भयं तावदपैतु वः ।। 7.61.1 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvadbhirṛṣibhiḥ kākutstho vākyamabravīt | kiṃ kāryaṃ brūta munayo bhayaṃ tāvadapaitu vaḥ || 7.61.1 ||
translation: एवम् thus, ब्रुवद्भिः by those speaking, ऋषिभिः by the sages, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, किम् what, कार्यम् task, ब्रूत tell, मुनयः O sages, भयम् fear, तावत् first of all, अपैतु let it depart, वः from you.
explanation: When the sages spoke thus, Rama replied, "O sages, tell me what the task is; first of all, let your fear depart."
comments: Chyavana tells the origin of their fear: the devout demon Madhu won from Rudra a mighty trident that reduces any challenger to ashes, to pass to one of his sons -- Madhu's son Lavana, born of Kumbhinasi, wields it to torment the three worlds and the ascetics -- and, since Ravana is slain, they implore Rama to deliver them from Lavana.

shloka_text: तथा ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे भार्गवो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । भयानां शृणु यन्मूलं देशस्य च नरेश्वर ।। 7.61.2 ।।
transliteration: tathā bruvati kākutsthe bhārgavo vākyamabravīt | bhayānāṃ śṛṇu yanmūlaṃ deśasya ca nareśvara || 7.61.2 ||
translation: तथा thus, ब्रुवति when speaking, काकुत्स्थे Kakutstha (Rama), भार्गवः Bhargava (Chyavana), वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, भयानाम् of the fears, शृणु listen, यत् which, मूलम् origin, देशस्य of the region, च and, नरेश्वर O lord of men.
explanation: When Rama spoke thus, Bhargava (Chyavana) replied, "O King, listen to the origin of our fears and of this region."

shloka_text: पूर्वं कृतयुगे राजन्दैतेयः सुमहाबलः । लोलापुत्रो ऽभवज्ज्येष्ठो मधुर्नाम महासुरः ।। 7.61.3 ।।
transliteration: pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge rājandaiteyaḥ sumahābalaḥ | lolāputro 'bhavajjyeṣṭho madhurnāma mahāsuraḥ || 7.61.3 ||
translation: पूर्वम् formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राजन् O King, दैतेयः a Daitya, सुमहाबलः exceedingly powerful, लोलापुत्रः son of Lola, अभवत् was, ज्येष्ठः the eldest, मधुः Madhu, नाम named, महासुरः a great demon.
explanation: O King, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was an exceedingly powerful Daitya, the eldest son of Lola, named Madhu, who was a great demon.

shloka_text: ब्रह्मण्यश्च शरण्यश्च बुद्ध्या च परिनिष्ठितः । सुरैश्च परमोदारैः प्रीतिस्तस्यातुला ऽभवत् ।। 7.61.4 ।।
transliteration: brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca buddhyā ca pariniṣṭhitaḥ | suraiśca paramodāraiḥ prītistasyātulā 'bhavat || 7.61.4 ||
translation: ब्रह्मण्यश्च one devoted to Brahmins and, शरण्यश्च one who offers refuge and, बुद्ध्या by intellect, च and, परिनिष्ठितः firmly established, सुरैश्च with gods and, परमोदारैः exceedingly generous, प्रीतिः affection, तस्य for him, अतुला unequalled, अभवत् was
explanation: He was devoted to Brahmins, a protector, and firmly resolved in his wisdom, and he had an unequalled affection for the exceedingly generous gods.

shloka_text: स मधुर्वीर्यसम्पन्नो धर्मे च सुसमाहितः । बहुवर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रप्रीत्या ऽकरोत्तपः ।। 7.61.5 ।।
transliteration: sa madhurvīryasampanno dharme ca susamāhitaḥ | bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi rudraprītyā 'karottapaḥ || 7.61.5 ||
translation: सः he, मधुः Madhu, वीर्यसम्पन्नः endowed with valor, धर्मे in righteousness, च and, सुसमाहितः well-established, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, रुद्रप्रीत्या to please Rudra, अकरोत् performed, तपः penance
explanation: That Madhu, endowed with great valor and steadfast in righteousness, performed penance for many thousands of years to please Rudra.

shloka_text: रुद्रः प्रीतो ऽभवत्तस्मै वरं दातुं ययौ च सः । बहुमानाच्च रुद्रेण दत्तस्तस्याद्भुतो वरः ।। 7.61.6 ।।
transliteration: rudraḥ prīto 'bhavattasmai varaṃ dātuṃ yayau ca saḥ | bahumānācca rudreṇa dattastasyādbhuto varaḥ || 7.61.6 ||
translation: रुद्रः Rudra, प्रीतः pleased, अभवत् became, तस्मै for him, वरं boon, दातुम् to give, ययौ went, च and, सः he (Rudra), बहुमानात् with great respect, च and, रुद्रेण by Rudra, दत्तः given, तस्य for him, अद्भुतः wonderful, वरः boon
explanation: Rudra became pleased with him and went to grant a boon, and with great respect, an extraordinary boon was given to him by Rudra.

shloka_text: शूलं शूलाद्विनिष्कृष्य महावीर्यं महाप्रभम् । ददौ महात्मा सुप्रीतो वाक्यं चैतदुवाच ह ।। 7.61.7 ।।
transliteration: śūlaṃ śūlādviniṣkṛṣya mahāvīryaṃ mahāprabham | dadau mahātmā suprīto vākyaṃ caitaduvāca ha || 7.61.7 ||
translation: शूलं trident, शूलात् from his own trident, विनिष्कृष्य extracting, महावीर्यं of great power, महाप्रभम् of great splendor, ददौ gave, महात्मा the great-souled one, सुप्रीतः very pleased, वाक्यं words, च and, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed
explanation: The great-souled Rudra, very pleased, extracted a trident of great power and splendor from his own trident, gave it, and indeed spoke these words.

shloka_text: त्वयायमतुलो धर्मो मत्प्रसादकरः कृतः । प्रीत्या परमया युक्तो ददाम्यायुधमुत्तमम् ।। 7.61.8 ।।
transliteration: tvayāyamatulo dharmo matprasādakaraḥ kṛtaḥ | prītyā paramayā yukto dadāmyāyudhamuttamam || 7.61.8 ||
translation: त्वया by you, अयम् this, अतुलः unequalled, धर्मः righteousness, मत् my, प्रसादकरः pleasing, कृतः done, प्रीत्या with affection, परमया supreme, युक्तः endowed, ददामि I give, आयुधम् weapon, उत्तमम् excellent
explanation: “This unequalled act of righteousness, which pleases me, has been performed by you; filled with supreme affection, I give you this excellent weapon.”

shloka_text: यावत्सुरैश्च विप्रैश्च न विरुध्येर्महासुर । तावच्छूलं तवेदं स्यादन्यथा नाशमेप्यति ।। 7.61.9 ।।
transliteration: yāvatsuraiśca vipraiśca na virudhyermahāsura | tāvacchūlaṃ tavedaṃ syādanyathā nāśamepyati || 7.61.9 ||
translation: यावत् as long as, सुरैः with gods, च and, विप्रैः with Brahmins, च and, न not, विरुध्येः you contend/oppose, महासुर O great Asura, तावत् so long, शूलं the spear, तव your, इदं this, स्यात् shall be, अन्यथा otherwise, नाशम् destruction, एष्यति it will attain.
explanation: O great Asura, as long as you do not contend with gods and Brahmins, this spear shall remain yours; otherwise, it will meet its destruction.

shloka_text: यश्च त्वामभियुञ्जीत युद्धाय विगतज्वरः । तं शूलो भस्मसात्कृत्वा पुनरेष्यति ते करम् ।। 7.61.10 ।।
transliteration: yaśca tvāmabhiyuñjīta yuddhāya vigatajvaraḥ | taṃ śūlo bhasmasātkṛtvā punareṣyati te karam || 7.61.10 ||
translation: यः whoever, च and, त्वाम् you, अभियुञ्जीत challenges, युद्धाय for battle, विगतज्वरः free from fear, तम् him, शूलः the spear, भस्मसात्कृत्वा having reduced to ashes, पुनः again, एष्यति it will come, ते your, करम् hand.
explanation: Whoever fearlessly challenges you to battle, the spear will reduce him to ashes and then return to your hand.

shloka_text: एवं रुद्राद्वरं लब्ध्वा भूय एव महासुरः । प्रणिपत्य महादेवं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.61.11 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ rudrādvaraṃ labdhvā bhūya eva mahāsuraḥ | praṇipatya mahādevaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.61.11 ||
translation: एवम् thus, रुद्रात् from Rudra, वरम् a boon, लब्ध्वा having obtained, भूयः again, एव indeed, महासुरः the great Asura, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, महादेवं to the great god, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Having thus obtained a boon from Rudra, the great Asura bowed down to the great god and spoke these words again.

shloka_text: भगवन्मम वंशस्य शूलमेतदनुत्तमम् । भवेत्तु सततं देव सुराणामीश्वरो ह्यसि ।। 7.61.12 ।।
transliteration: bhagavanmama vaṃśasya śūlametadanuttamam | bhavettu satataṃ deva surāṇāmīśvaro hyasi || 7.61.12 ||
translation: भगवन् O Lord, मम my, वंशस्य of the lineage, शूलम् the spear, एतत् this, अनुत्तमम् excellent, भवेत् may it be, तु indeed, सततम् always, देव O God, सुराणाम् of the gods, ईश्वरः the lord, हि for, असि you are.
explanation: O Lord, may this excellent spear always remain with my lineage, for you are indeed the lord of the gods.

shloka_text: तं ब्रुवाणं मधुं देवः सर्वभूतपतिः शिवः । प्रत्युवाच महातेजा नैतदेवं भविष्यति ।। 7.61.13 ।।
transliteration: taṃ bruvāṇaṃ madhuṃ devaḥ sarvabhūtapatiḥ śivaḥ | pratyuvāca mahātejā naitadevaṃ bhaviṣyati || 7.61.13 ||
translation: तम् to him, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, मधुम् to Madhu, देवः the god, सर्वभूतपतिः lord of all beings, शिवः Shiva, प्रत्युवाच replied, महातेजा greatly effulgent, न not, एतत् this, एवम् thus, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: To Madhu, who was speaking thus, the greatly effulgent god Shiva, the lord of all beings, replied, "This will not be so."

shloka_text: मा भूत्ते विफला वाणी मत्प्रसादकृता शुभा । भवतः पुत्रमेकं तु शूलमेतद्भजिष्यते ।। 7.61.14 ।।
transliteration: mā bhūtte viphalā vāṇī matprasādakṛtā śubhā | bhavataḥ putramekaṃ tu śūlametadbhajiṣyate || 7.61.14 ||
translation: मा भूत् let it not be, ते your, विफला fruitless, वाणी word/speech, मत्प्रसादकृता made by my grace, शुभा auspicious, भवतः your, पुत्रम् son, एकम् one, तु indeed, शूलम् trident, एतत् this, भजिष्यते will possess.
explanation: May your auspicious words, granted by my grace, not be in vain; indeed, only one of your sons will possess this trident.

shloka_text: यावत्करस्थः शूलो ऽयं भविष्यति सुतस्य ते । अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां शूलहस्तो भविष्यति ।। 7.61.15 ।।
transliteration: yāvatkarasthaḥ śūlo 'yaṃ bhaviṣyati sutasya te | avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ śūlahasto bhaviṣyati || 7.61.15 ||
translation: यावत् as long as, करस्थः in hand, शूलः trident, अयम् this, भविष्यति will be, सुतस्य of the son, ते your, अवध्यः unslayable, सर्वभूतानाम् by all beings, शूलहस्तः one with a trident in hand, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: As long as this trident remains in your son's hand, he will be invincible to all beings, being one who wields the trident.

shloka_text: एवं मधुर्वरं लब्ध्वा देवात्सुमहदद्भुतम् । भवनं सो ऽसुरश्रेष्ठः कारयामास सुप्रभम् ।। 7.61.16 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ madhurvaraṃ labdhvā devātsumahadadbhutam | bhavanaṃ so 'suraśreṣṭhaḥ kārayāmāsa suprabham || 7.61.16 ||
translation: एवम् thus, मधुः Madhu, वरम् boon, लब्ध्वा having obtained, देवात् from the god, सुमहत् very great, अद्भुतम् wonderful, भवनम् dwelling/city, सः he, असुरश्रेष्ठः best of demons, कारयामास caused to be built, सुप्रभम् very splendid.
explanation: Thus, having obtained this very great and wonderful boon from the god, Madhu, the best of demons, caused a splendid city to be built.

shloka_text: तस्य पत्नी महाभागा प्रिया कुम्भीनसीति या । विश्वावसोरपत्यं सा ह्यनलायां महाप्रभा ।। 7.61.17 ।।
transliteration: tasya patnī mahābhāgā priyā kumbhīnasīti yā | viśvāvasorapatyaṃ sā hyanalāyāṃ mahāprabhā || 7.61.17 ||
translation: तस्य his, पत्नी wife, महाभागा highly fortunate, प्रिया beloved, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, इति thus, या who, विश्वावसोः of Vishvavasu, अपत्यम् offspring/daughter, सा she, हि indeed, अनलायाम् in Anala, महाप्रभा very radiant.
explanation: His beloved and highly fortunate wife was Kumbhinasi, who was indeed the very radiant daughter of Vishvavasu by Anala.

shloka_text: तस्याः पुत्रो महावीर्यो लवणो नाम दारुणः । बाल्यात्प्रभृति दुष्टात्मा पापान्येव समाचरत् ।। 7.61.18 ।।
transliteration: tasyāḥ putro mahāvīryo lavaṇo nāma dāruṇaḥ | bālyātprabhṛti duṣṭātmā pāpānyeva samācarat || 7.61.18 ||
translation: तस्याः her, पुत्रः son, महावीर्यः very powerful, लवणः Lavana, नाम named, दारुणः terrible, बाल्यात्प्रभृति from childhood onwards, दुष्टात्मा evil-minded, पापानि sins, एव only, समाचरत् committed.
explanation: Her son was the very powerful and terrible Lavana, who, being evil-minded, committed only sinful deeds from his childhood onwards.

shloka_text: तं पुत्रं दुर्विनीतं तु दृष्ट्वा क्रोधसमन्वितः । मधुः स शोकमापेदे न चैनं किञ्चिदब्रवीत् ।। 7.61.19 ।।
transliteration: taṃ putraṃ durvinītaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā krodhasamanvitaḥ | madhuḥ sa śokamāpede na cainaṃ kiñcidabravīt || 7.61.19 ||
translation: तं that, पुत्रं son, दुर्विनीतं ill-behaved, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, क्रोधसमन्वितः filled with anger, मधुः Madhu, सः he, शोकम् sorrow, आपेदे attained, न not, च and, एनं him, किञ्चित् anything, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Seeing his ill-behaved son, Madhu was filled with anger and sorrow, yet he did not say anything to him.

shloka_text: स विहाय त्विमं लोकं प्रविष्टो वरुणालयम् । शूलं निवेश्य लवणे वरं तस्मै न्यवेदयत् ।। 7.61.20 ।।
transliteration: sa vihāya tvimaṃ lokaṃ praviṣṭo varuṇālayam | śūlaṃ niveśya lavaṇe varaṃ tasmai nyavedayat || 7.61.20 ||
translation: सः he (Madhu), विहाय having abandoned, तु indeed, इमं this, लोकं world, प्रविष्टो entered, वरुणालयम् the abode of Varuna, शूलं the trident, निवेश्य having placed, लवणे to Lavana, वरं a boon, तस्मै to him, न्यवेदयत् offered.
explanation: Madhu, having left this world, entered the abode of Varuna, and after placing the trident with Lavana, he offered a boon to him.

shloka_text: स प्रभावेण शूलस्य दौरात्म्येनात्मनस्तथा । सन्तापयति लोकांस्त्रीन्विशेषेण च तापसान् ।। 7.61.21 ।।
transliteration: sa prabhāveṇa śūlasya daurātmyenātmanastathā | santāpayati lokāṃstrīnviśeṣeṇa ca tāpasān || 7.61.21 ||
translation: सः he (Lavana), प्रभावेण by the power, शूलस्य of the trident, दौरात्म्येनात्मनस्तथा and by his own wickedness, सन्तापयति torments, लोकांस्त्रीन् the three worlds, विशेषेण especially, च and, तापसान् ascetics.
explanation: Lavana, by the power of the trident and his own wickedness, torments the three worlds, especially the ascetics.

shloka_text: एवंप्रभावो लवणः शूलं चैव तथाविधम् । श्रुत्वा प्रमाणं काकुत्स्थ त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः ।। 7.61.22 ।।
transliteration: evaṃprabhāvo lavaṇaḥ śūlaṃ caiva tathāvidham | śrutvā pramāṇaṃ kākutstha tvaṃ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ || 7.61.22 ||
translation: एवंप्रभावो such is the power, लवणः of Lavana, शूलं the trident, च and, एव indeed, तथाविधम् of such a kind, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रमाणं (you are our) authority/refuge, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha (Rama), त्वं you, हि indeed, नः our, परमा ultimate, गतिः refuge.
explanation: Having heard of Lavana's power and the nature of his trident, O Rama, you are our ultimate refuge and authority.

shloka_text: बहवः पार्थिवा राम भयार्तैर्ऋषिभिः पुरा । अभयं याचिता वीर त्रातारं न च विद्महे ।। 7.61.23 ।।
transliteration: bahavaḥ pārthivā rāma bhayārtairṛṣibhiḥ purā | abhayaṃ yācitā vīra trātāraṃ na ca vidmahe || 7.61.23 ||
translation: बहवः many, पार्थिवा kings, राम O Rama, भयार्तैः by those afflicted with fear, ऋषिभिः by sages, पुरा formerly, अभयं protection, याचिता were implored, वीर O hero, त्रातारं a protector, न not, च and, विद्महे we know.
explanation: O Rama, many kings were formerly implored for protection by fear-stricken sages, but we do not know of any true protector.

shloka_text: ते वयं रावणं श्रुत्वा हतं सबलवाहनम् । त्रातारं विद्महे तात नान्यं भुवि नराधिपम् । तत्परित्रातुमिच्छामो लवणाद्भयपीडितान् ।। 7.61.24 ।।
transliteration: te vayaṃ rāvaṇaṃ śrutvā hataṃ sabalavāhanam | trātāraṃ vidmahe tāta nānyaṃ bhuvi narādhipam | tatparitrātumicchāmo lavaṇādbhayapīḍitān || 7.61.24 ||
translation: ते those, वयम् we, रावणम् Ravana, श्रुत्वा having heard, हतम् killed, सबलवाहनम् with his army and vehicles, त्रातारम् protector, विद्महे we know, तात O dear one, न not, अन्यम् another, भुवि on earth, नराधिपम् king, तत् therefore, परित्रातुम् to protect, इच्छामः we wish, लवणात् from Lavana, भयपीडितान् those afflicted by fear.
explanation: Having heard that Ravana, along with his army and vehicles, has been killed, we know no other king on earth as a protector, and therefore, O dear one, we wish for you to protect those afflicted by fear from Lavana.

shloka_text: इति राम निवेदितं तु ते भयजं कारणमुत्थितं च यत् । विनिवारयितुं भवान्क्षमः कुरु तं काममहीनविक्रम ।। 7.61.25 ।।
transliteration: iti rāma niveditaṃ tu te bhayajaṃ kāraṇamutthitaṃ ca yat | vinivārayituṃ bhavānkṣamaḥ kuru taṃ kāmamahīnavikrama || 7.61.25 ||
translation: इति thus, राम O Rama, निवेदितम् reported, तु indeed, ते by them, भयजम् born of fear, कारणम् cause, उत्थितम् arisen, च and, यत् which, विनिवारयितुम् to remove, भवान् you, क्षमः capable, कुरु do, तम् that, कामम् wish, अहीनविक्रम O one of undiminished valor.
explanation: O Rama of undiminished valor, you are capable of removing this cause of fear that has arisen and been reported, so please fulfill that wish. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 61 ।। Thus ends the sixty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
